Author: Sandro
Name: NahjaUI
Punchline: A complete, modular interface for Final Fantasy XIV.
Description:
NahjaUI gives the game a clean, consistent interface that you build piece by piece. Switch on only what you want: everything else stays exactly as the game made it.

HUD bars: your parameter bar, target, target of target, focus target and party list.
Progress bars: your casts and your target's, with a slidecast marker, plus a global cooldown bar that shows the queue and weave windows.
Job gauges, status effects, nameplates and enmity list, each one with its own style.
Trackers: pick the enhancements, enfeeblements and cooldowns you want to see. Every job comes with ready-made presets.
Profiles: save, copy and share your whole setup.

Type /nui to open it.

Join the testers on Discord: https://nahjaui.github.io/discord
Changelog: Added: a setup window opens the first time you install NahjaUI: pick Essential, Complete or Trackers only, then place everything with Unlock Mode. You can run it again from General or with /nui setup. Added: new installs start from a ready-made Black Mage interface instead of an empty one. Added: Black Mage Paradox aura, two spirals of fire and ice shown while Paradox can be cast. Added: a slow animated background for the menu and the setup window, with a switch in Appearance to turn it off. Changed: the cards of the menu are a little see-through. Changed: the PREVIEW label sits higher above the elements. Fix: the game's target bar is now hidden too when Display Target Info Independently is off in the HUD layout of the game.
